from pathlib import Path
import base64,json,secrets,shlex,struct,subprocess
hold=Path.home()/'.local/share/phone-lock/priority-hold'
if hold.exists(): raise SystemExit(0)
adb=['adb','-s','002473611000997']
apk=subprocess.check_output([*adb,'shell','pm','path','dev.torssh'],timeout=20).decode().strip().removeprefix('package:')
exe=str(Path(apk).parent/'lib/arm64/libtorcore_lyrebird.so')
report=[]
for stage,cmd in [('two-step','exec 3<&0; exec "$1" --torssh-launch-fd=3'),('one-step','exec "$1" --torssh-launch-fd=3 3<&0')]:
 if hold.exists(): break
 config={'version':1,'token':secrets.token_hex(32),'transport':'obfs4','bridges':[{'address':'127.0.0.1:9','options':{'cert':base64.b64encode(bytes(52)).decode().rstrip('='),'iat-mode':'0'}}]}
 raw=json.dumps(config).encode(); frame=struct.pack('!I',len(raw))+raw
 script='state="$PWD/no_backup/lyrebird42-shell"; mkdir -p "$state"; chmod 700 "$state"; cat | env -i TOR_PT_MANAGED_TRANSPORT_VER=1 TOR_PT_EXIT_ON_STDIN_CLOSE=1 TOR_PT_CLIENT_TRANSPORTS=obfs4 TOR_PT_STATE_LOCATION="$state" /system/bin/sh -c '+shlex.quote(cmd)+' probe '+shlex.quote(exe)+'; result=$?; rm -rf "$state"; exit "$result"'
 r=subprocess.run([*adb,'shell',shlex.join(['run-as','dev.torssh','/system/bin/sh','-c',script])],input=frame,capture_output=True,timeout=20)
 report.append(f'{stage} exit={r.returncode} handshake={b"CMETHODS DONE" in r.stdout} stderr_empty={not r.stderr}')
text='\n'.join(report)+'\n'
Path('tmp/lyrebird42/phone-shell-control.txt').write_text(text)
print(text,end='')
PY
python3 tmp/lyrebird42/shell-control.py
tail -10 tmp/lyrebird42/diagnostic-build.log
